semantics: Family correspondence with optional per-family selectors over published geometric record fields, independently of labels. All selectors on a family must match; unselected families retain every record. Only defining faces count; bottom labels and constituent faces do not expand predictions. Identical face sets across mapped families are one prediction. Stock is not covered: polygonal_stock describes a body, not residual unmachined faces.

classes.name: chamfer
classes.rationale: The internal scorer keeps principal chamfers and oriented_chamfers separately, while recognition schema 6 publishes both as chamfers. oriented_chamfers proves a complete planar replacement bevel between two supports, including material-side and virtual-corner evidence; the same defining-face set is deduplicated across families.

holes.evidence: A proved through bore has two open ends. Flat and drill-point bottoms close blind bores; unknown ends do not prove a through bore. Select the published termination independently of labels.

section_passages.evidence: The published straight section coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals. A complete triangle, rectangle (four right angles), or regular hexagon (equal edges and sixty-degree exterior turns) decides the canonical profile independently of labels. Exclude only another such complete profile; retain altered, intersected, curved and unresolved profiles under the existing coarse correspondence. Raw edge count alone is insufficient after treatments or intersections.

classes.name: rectangular_passage
classes.rationale: An enclosed rectangular through cut. Rust publishes principal rectangles as section_passages and non-principal rectangles as oriented_slots; independent OpenCascade aligned and rotated box-minus-prism constructions verify both representations.

classes.name: triangular_through_slot
classes.rationale: Two rectangular planar walls meet concavely at a straight trough edge; their opposite lips lie in one open plane, and both run ends open to exterior planar faces. The v_channels family proves this V-section through-channel geometry, without selecting by labels or preferring a section angle. A wall pair contained in a proved closed passage is excluded as part of that complete section.

classes.name: rectangular_through_slot
classes.rationale: The generator extrudes a rectangle anchored to one stock edge through the stock normal. Along that through axis the remaining boundary is a U-section: two opposed walls and a floor, open at both ends. This is Rust channels, not the enclosed passage/slot interpretation. Verified with an independent OpenCascade box-minus-prism construction.

classes.name: circular_through_slot

section_recesses.evidence: A proved open section swept between two open run ends is a through channel.
The published circular open profile is the concave cylindrical trough; cylindrical_seats proves the original support, open mouth and both open ends by coverage and volume probes.

classes.rationale: The existing section_recesses family already publishes proved circular open channels, including the semicircular trough of circular_through_slot. Select its published channel and circular classification, without changing recognition or using labels.

classes.name: rectangular_through_step
classes.rationale: Rectangular step remnants may end at a secondary cut inside the stock envelope. local_steps proves two complete perpendicular walls, a continuous concave seam, convex lips, unique perpendicular exterior end faces and an empty removed quadrant. Only the two defining wall regions count; end-face context is not claimed. Full-length through_steps retains its original contract.

classes.name: slanted_through_step
classes.rationale: Polygonal principal walls with a complete rectangular oblique wall, a unique parallel convex lip, convex exterior run ends and an empty polygon sweep are slanted through steps. Only the two walls are defining; the exact polygon is retained. Legacy oblique_through_steps stays unchanged.

classes.name: Oring
classes.rationale: A blind annular face recess: a planar annular floor region joins a complete outer concave cylinder and inner convex cylinder, both ending at the same open plane. The annular_grooves family proves every floor piece and both cylindrical walls on one valid solid; split rims must be complete circular cycles. Existing grooves are external shaft bands and do not describe this geometry. No nominal O-ring size or function is inferred.

holes.evidence: A proved through bore has two open ends and cannot be a blind hole. A flat or drill-point end closes a blind bore. Unknown ends remain ambiguous under the existing coarse correspondence; this selector does not assert a blind termination for them.

pockets.evidence: A proved corner notch at two stock edges is not a closed circular-end pocket. A null end radius alone cannot classify an altered profile, so those ambiguous records retain the existing correspondence.

A published rectangular_boundary=true proves one intact four-line planar floor with four full-height inward planar walls concave to its edges, on a uniquely owned cavity. This is a closed rectangular boundary, so it cannot be a circular-end pocket or an edge-anchored corner step. False leaves modified or unproved boundaries under the existing correspondence; a null end radius alone is not a rectangle proof.

classes.name: rectangular_blind_slot

section_recesses.evidence: An already-proved open section with one capped run end and one open run end is a blind edge-open recess.

Five straight published profile vertices prove exactly two parallel sides, one flat floor and a flared lip bevel at one mouth edge. Both run end planes are normal to the run; exactly one is capped. The run must be strictly longer than both nominal width and depth, beyond publication uncertainty, so ambiguous slot roles stay excluded. Profile coordinates publish 4 decimals and run stations 3. The existing section-recess proof supplies complete sweep, support, mouth, cap and valid-solid evidence. Its defining bevel face remains part of scoring; labels do not remove it.

classes.rationale: Legacy rectangular_blind_slots plus already-proved lip-bevelled rectangular U sweeps with one planar blind cap and uniquely longer run. Keep their existing defining faces, including the bevel; do not expand cap context into predictions or weaken ambiguous-role refusals.

classes.name: v_circular_end_blind_slot
classes.rationale: A complete semicylindrical floor tangent to two rectangular vertical sides, swept from an open run end to a planar blind cap. The semicircular_blind_slots family proves that geometry and its open lateral mouth on one strictly valid solid. The older round_bottom_blind_slots family describes two quarter-cylinder corners with a flat floor, which is the h_circular_end_blind_slot geometry, not this class.

classes.name: h_circular_end_blind_slot
classes.rationale: Open U-section with two quarter-circle corners and a flat between them, extruded to a blind cap.

classes.name: triangular_blind_step
classes.rationale: Triangular sketch anchored to two stock edges, cut blind: an oblique corner face and triangular terminal.

classes.name: rectangular_blind_step
classes.rationale: Rectangular sketch anchored to two stock edges, cut blind: a corner notch (pockets edge_anchored).

pockets.evidence: A proved half-cylindrical pocket end is not a rectangular corner step. The remaining profiles retain their existing coarse correspondence because edge_anchored=false alone cannot classify intersected or treated corners.

classes.name: round

blends.evidence: The published convex or concave material side proves respectively an external or internal edge round along a complete rolling-ball path between smooth supports. MFInstSeg round includes both external and internal fillets. Ambiguous or unproved sides are excluded; labels never choose a record at scoring time.

classes.rationale: MFInstSeg round covers both external rounds and internal fillets. The blends recogniser proves complete rolling paths with smooth supports and a uniform convex or concave material side. Select these published sides and deduplicate against legacy fillets; #89 still restricts the fillets family to convex faces. No fillet radius or material-side rule changes.

classes.name: stock
classes.not_covered: Residual stock faces have no recognition family.
